sources.title: Dhruv Jain - University of Michigan
sources.snippet: AI for Sound Accessibility: How can AI make sound, speech, and noisy environments more accessible? We build systems for sound awareness, acoustic control, and communication access, helping deaf and hard-of-hearing people, people with noise sensitivity, and clinicians working in high-noise environments better understand and manage sound.
